title: John Lennon and Paul McCartney sell their Northern Songs shares to ATV | 1969
content:
The Beatles lost control of Northern Songs on 19 September 1969, when ATV took a 54% controlling stake in the company.

John Lennon and Paul McCartney took some weeks to decide what to do with their Northern Songs shares. On 15 October they sold the shares to ATV, receiving £3.5 million in ATV loan stock. Lennon received £1.39 million, and McCartney got £1.5 million.
